name: Big Larch Campground
evidence: rec.gov 234346 per-site catalog: no Proximity-to-Water flag on any of 53 sites; site coords (BLS01-BLS27) plotted on satellite at 47.1866,-113.4955 sit ~190 m E of Seeley Lake behind continuous conifer forest; beach is separate day use

name: Beaver Creek Campground (Spotted Bear River)
evidence: FS page '<100 ft to the river' is prose, no per-site map/rec.gov; satellite at 47.9236,-113.3736: pads resolvable on the loop sit ~50-70 m from the Spotted Bear gravel bar behind old-growth conifers; no upgrade, stored view kept

name: Rainbow Point Campground
evidence: rec.gov 233131: no Proximity-to-Water flag on any of 84 sites; site coords on satellite at 44.7790,-111.1770: Loops C/D nearest pads ~80-100 m from Rainbow Bay behind a shoreline road and continuous treeline, Loop A ~130 m+; beach/ramp are day use

name: Pete Creek Campground
evidence: FS EDW road 1114 (PETE CR CAMPGROUND) puts the loop inside the Yaak River bend S of Hwy 508; satellite at 48.8300,-115.7672 canopy-blind (dense conifer), pads not resolvable; not on rec.gov, no FS per-site map; 'access to the Yaak River' is prose; default down

name: Wayfarers Unit - Flathead Lake State Park
evidence: FWP wayfarers_trail_map.pdf: campground loop in the park's SW corner ~100 m inland of the rocky shoreline; satellite at 48.0535,-114.0800: loop in continuous conifer forest, lake screened; RA 'Near Water' tag decides nothing

name: Coal Banks Landing
evidence: BLM page: 20 sites W of the contact station; satellite at 48.0318,-110.2362: open gravel bench, nearest tables ~20-25 m from the Missouri but across the boat-ramp apron (used) with a cottonwood band E; west sites behind a treeline/bank ~60-120 m; river visible through ramp gap

name: Holland Lake Campground
evidence: FS Bay Loop map (cdn.recreation.gov 75370_HOLA.pdf p3): south-spur sites (rec.gov 018, 020, 021; RV/trailer) end ~15-20 m from the lake with no road between; rec.gov site coords ~27-37 m from shore on satellite at 47.4506,-113.6072, open conifer canopy, pads not resolvable

name: Murray Bay Campground
evidence: rec.gov 250035 per-site 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' on RV/trailer sites 02-06, 08, 11, 12 (33-60 ft); satellite at 48.2658,-113.8155: spurs of 05/06/08 ~13-27 m from the full-pool beach edge of Hungry Horse Reservoir through thin open conifer (drawdown beach beyond)
